description: Cuestionario Consolidado No 6 — Evidencia 6 — 25 ítems de selección múltiple — 5 secciones (Reading, Vocabulary, Grammar, Listening, Language Functions) — sesión 6 'Prove What You Know'

administration_conditions.materials_permitted: NINGUNO — sin Word Wall, sin Communication Card, sin notas, sin diccionario, sin teléfono
administration_conditions.materials_permitted_es: NINGUNO — ni Word Wall, ni Communication Card, ni notas, ni diccionario, ni teléfono
administration_conditions.format: Selección múltiple con única respuesta — encierra en círculo la letra correcta
administration_conditions.scoring: 1 punto por respuesta correcta. 0 puntos por respuesta incorrecta o en blanco. No hay puntos negativos.

student_instructions.en: Read each question carefully. Circle the letter of the correct answer (a, b, or c). For True/False questions, circle TRUE or FALSE. You may NOT use any materials. Time: 90 minutes. Good luck, Workshop Specialist.
student_instructions.es: Lee cada pregunta con atención. Encierra en círculo la letra de la respuesta correcta (a, b o c). En preguntas de Verdadero/Falso, encierra TRUE o FALSE. NO puedes usar ningún material. Tiempo: 90 minutos. ¡Buena suerte, Workshop Specialist!

sections.title: SECTION 1 — READING COMPREHENSION
sections.subtitle: Tools Every Diesel Technician Needs
sections.context_note: Answer the questions based on the article you read in Session 2.
sections.context_note_es: Responde las preguntas basándote en el artículo que leíste en la Sesión 2.

items.question: What is the main topic of the article?
A torque wrench is used to ___.

options.b: apply the correct force to a bolt

items.question: True or False: The ratchet works well in large spaces.
items.note: The article states: 'The ratchet is fast in tight spaces.'

items.question: Where does a technician keep tools organized?
What does 'calibration' mean in the article?

options.b: Checking that the tool is accurate

sections.title: SECTION 2 — VOCABULARY
sections.subtitle: Toolbelt — 20 Technical Terms
sections.context_note: Answer the questions about the 20 Toolbelt terms from the course.
sections.context_note_es: Responde las preguntas sobre los 30 términos del Toolbelt del curso.

items.question: What is a 'workbench'?

options.b: A flat surface to work on

items.question: 'Hazard' means ___.
Which of these is PPE (Personal Protective Equipment)?
A 'work order' is ___.

options.a: an instruction to lift a vehicle
options.b: a document describing a repair task

items.question: 'Preventive maintenance' means ___.

sections.title: SECTION 3 — GRAMMAR
sections.subtitle: Imperatives — There is/are — Prepositions of Place
sections.context_note: Answer the grammar questions about imperatives, There is/are, and prepositions of place.
sections.context_note_es: Responde las preguntas de gramática sobre imperativos, There is/are y preposiciones de lugar.

items.question: Which sentence is an imperative?
Complete the sentence: '___ a spill near the bay door.'
Complete the sentence: 'The tools ___ in the toolbox.'
items.grammar_target: There is / There are — plural agreement

items.question: Complete the sentence: 'The fire extinguisher is ___ the bay door.'
Which sentence has a correct preposition of place?

options.a: The wrench is near of the workbench.
options.b: The wrench is on the workbench.
options.c: The wrench is in front the workbench.

sections.title: SECTION 4 — LISTENING COMPREHENSION
sections.subtitle: Bay 2 Safety Briefing — Carlos and Valentina
sections.context_note: Answer the questions about the Bay 2 Safety Briefing dialogue from Session 4.
sections.context_note_es: Responde las preguntas sobre el diálogo Bay 2 Safety Briefing de la Sesión 4.

items.question: In the dialogue, who is the supervisor?
What PPE does Carlos ask Valentina to wear?
Where is the oil spill in the dialogue?
Carlos says the fire extinguisher is always ___.
What does Valentina say at the end of the dialogue?

sections.title: SECTION 5 — LANGUAGE FUNCTIONS
sections.subtitle: 5 Communication Functions of The Diesel Workshop
sections.context_note: Answer the questions about the 5 communication functions from Session 5.
sections.context_note_es: Responde las preguntas sobre las 5 funciones comunicativas de la Sesión 5.

functions_reference.F2: Solicitar herramientas — Requesting tools/help (Can I have / I need)
functions_reference.F3: Describir condiciones — Describing conditions (There is/are + preposition)
functions_reference.F4: Reportar al supervisor — Reporting to supervisor (Bay ___ is ready, Carlos)
functions_reference.F5: Confirmar comprensión — Confirming understanding (Understood / Got it)

items.question: Carlos says: 'Check the torque wrench.' What communication function is this?
Valentina says: 'Can I have the socket set?' What function is this?
'There is a spill near Bay 2.' What communication function is this?
Santiago says: 'Bay 3 is ready, Carlos.' What function is this?
Valentina says: 'Got it. I'll do it now.' What function is this?

score_bands.23_25: Destacado — dominio sólido de A1.1 en las 5 habilidades
score_bands.18_22: Competente — A1.1 logrado con áreas de refuerzo menores
score_bands.13_17: Básico — A1.1 parcialmente logrado — refuerzo recomendado
score_bands.8_12: En proceso — revisión de habilidades específicas necesaria

section_diagnostic.note: Si un aprendiz obtiene < 3/5 en una sección — esa habilidad necesita refuerzo antes de la siguiente guía.
section_diagnostic.reading_low: Refuerzo: relectura del artículo + preguntas de inferencia adicionales
section_diagnostic.grammar_low: Refuerzo: Error Log S3 + Grammar Stations S3
section_diagnostic.listening_low: Refuerzo: re-escucha del diálogo + role-play adicional
section_diagnostic.functions_low: Refuerzo: Personal Communication Card S5 + drills F1–F5

instructor_notes.distribution: Distribuir Cuestionario CARA ABAJO. Estudiantes escriben nombre y fecha antes de voltear.
instructor_notes.collection: Recoger TODOS los formularios antes de revisar cualquier respuesta.
instructor_notes.review_session: Revisión en WHILE-B de S6: 3 min por pregunta × 25 = 75 min. Para cada pregunta: leer → estudiantes votan a/b/c → revelar respuesta → explicar razonamiento (citar fuente de sesión).
instructor_notes.return: Cuestionario devuelto con puntaje total + puntaje por sección + diagnóstico breve.
instructor_notes.contribution: Evidencia 6 — contribuye a la calificación final según GFPI-F-134 y peso institucional de la ficha.
